name: Chicago Golf Club
architects: Charles Blair Macdonald (1895); rebuilt by Seth Raynor (1923)

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM, project IL_MidNorth_D22, tile x40y464 (published 2023-10-31), clipped to the world + 100 m by pipeline/intake.py raster; fetched by the GitHub Actions fetch workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-chicago_golf)

ortho.source: USDA NAIP 2023, 0.3 m, tiles m_4108815_ne and m_4108816_nw (16 and 24 August 2023; public domain), joined and warped to EPSG:32616 at 0.5 m by make_ortho.py; fetched by the GitHub Actions fetch workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-chicago_golf); lines up with OSM bunkers and greens within about 1.5 m

laz.source: USGS 3DEP lidar point cloud IL_MidNorth_D22, classes 3-5, clipped to the world + 100 m by pipeline/intake.py laz; fetched by the GitHub Actions fetch workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-chicago_golf)
laz.label: USGS lidar (IL_MidNorth_D22)

world.note: OSM course boundary way/281979769 bbox (816 x 1,149 m) + scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred: 1,280 m east-west (232 m each side), 1,536 m north-south (193 m each side)

scorecard_source: The club's printed scorecard (photo posted by golfbycoop, Instagram, 2025-08-25, supplied by the developer 2026-11-13): Black 6,950 / White 6,571 / Red 5,664 yd, par 70, men's handicap row. Ratings from the USGA Course Rating and Slope Database (developer's screenshot, 2026-11-13): men's Black 74.4/141, White 72.5/137, Red 68.4/127 (women's Black 81.0/147, White 78.9/144, Red 74.2/133, par 72). Third-party sites give holes 11 and 12 handicaps 4 and 6; the card's 6 and 4 are used.
attribution: Elevation and trees: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (IL_MidNorth_D22 lidar)
